summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill focused on brush configuration parameters (extent, filtering, touch, modifiers, handle size) at the setup stage. It is semantically different from the peer 'Brush Selection and Manipulation' (1bd0b637) which covers the full brush lifecycle (instantiation through event handling and manipulation). The candidate addresses pre-interaction customization of brush behavior, while the peer addresses the complete interaction workflow. No existing skill in the registry matches this narrower configuration-focused capability. The peer candidates (curve tuning, symbol configuration) are in different task families and do not overlap. The existing skills in the registry are unrelated (Spring Boot migration, DataStream transformation). This warrants creation as a new, focused micro-skill.
